name: Hoshizora Camp
description: Hoshizora Camp — a glamping-site theme laid out like an app: under a full top header, a deep-navy sidebar holds the synced camp board (tonight's sky, free tents, the fire circle, quiet hours and a Book a site button) beside the scrolling page. Hatobanezumi, the dove mauve-grey of traditional Japanese dyeing (#9E8B8E), is the main colour: the header, the hero, every page head and the silver-grass band are dove-grey fields with nōkon deep-navy type, on an unbleached kinari ground with pale shirafuji wisteria panels, keshimurasaki muted-purple links and small touches of kōiro incense gold and geppaku moon white on navy. The header splits the menu around the centred camp name, with the Book a site button at its end. The hero is a scene map: a watercolour map of the camp in a white frame with numbered pins for the lodge, tents, domes, star deck, fire circle and creek, and a cut-out bell tent that steps out of the frame and over the hero edge; a cut-out camp lantern hangs over the night band. Every picture is a watercolour illustration. Klee One for display, Gothic A1 for reading. The sample content comes in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: v1.0.2 recolour (2026-10-16): the main colour is now hatobanezumi dove mauve-grey #9E8B8E with a nōkon deep-navy night, for a quieter, more refined look; the sample meadow is now silver grass, and the pictures were regenerated in the new palette. Otherwise built to design-plan.json row b3-21 (sidebar-app, scene-map hero, split nav, full-illustration images, watercolour, Klee One + Gothic A1). Every picture is a watercolour raster illustration generated with Grok Build; break-frame: a cut-out bell tent steps out of the framed site map and over the hero edge, and a cut-out camp lantern hangs over the night band's top edge. Sample content in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de (demo-content.<lang>.json + inc/i18n/<lang>.php + inc/info/<lang>/). Contrast: nōkon navy #0F2350 on hatobanezumi #9E8B8E 4.75:1 (all text on the dove-grey header, hero, page heads and silver-grass band); navy on kinari paper #FBFAF5 14.6:1; keshimurasaki #594255 on paper 8.6:1 (links, labels); paper on keshimurasaki 8.6:1; keshimurasaki on shirafuji #DBD0E6 6.1:1; aisabi #455765 on paper 7.2:1 (secondary text); aisabi on shirafuji 5.1:1; navy on shirafuji 10.3:1; kōiro gold #EFCD9A on navy 10.1:1 (labels, times, prices on the sidebar and night band); geppaku #EAF4FC on navy 13.7:1; paper on navy 14.6:1; hatobanezumi on navy 4.75:1 (sidebar button, footer rule); navy on the white map frame 15.3:1; white on hatobanezumi only 3.2:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 鳩羽鼠灰配濃紺夜色的豪華露營地：左側濃紺營地看板，主視覺是水彩營地地圖，去背帳篷跨出畫框；樣本內容含五種語言。
summary.en: A dove-grey and deep-navy glamping site: a navy sidebar camp board, a watercolour site-map hero and a cut-out tent breaking its frame.
summary.ja: 鳩羽鼠と濃紺のグランピング場。濃紺のサイドバー掲示板、水彩の場内マップ、枠からはみ出す切り抜きテント。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Un glamping gris tourterelle et bleu nuit : tableau du camp en barre latérale, plan aquarelle en héros et tente détourée qui sort du cadre.
summary.de: Glamping in Taubengrau und Nachtblau: Lagertafel in der Seitenleiste, Aquarell-Lageplan als Hero, freigestelltes Zelt über dem Rahmen.
